ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "ok", timestamp: now() as String, method: attributes.method }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- (1 to vars.inputSize) map { id: $, name: "product-" ++ ($ as String), price: ($ * 7.3) + 0.99, quantity: ($ mod 20) + 1, active: ($ mod 5) != 0 }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload filter $.active map { id: $.id, name: upper($.name), total: $.price * $.quantity, tier: if ($.price > 200) "premium" else if ($.price > 100) "standard" else "basic" }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- (1 to 50) map { index: $, value: $ * $ , sqrt: sqrt($ as Number) }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { squares: (1 to 26) map ($ * $), numbers: (1 to 10) reduce ((item, acc = 0) -> acc + item) }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { message: "default route", routeType: vars.routeType }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { source: "io-pipeline", upstream: payload, processed: true }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { source: "io-subflow", tag: vars.tag, upstream: payload }
